arxiv-2109-07619.title: Structural Highness Notions Thanks: The second author was supported in part by Simons Foundation Collaboration Grant #420806. Portions of this material are based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. DMS-1928930 while the first author participated in a program hosted
arxiv-2109-07619.creator: Wesley Calvert, Johanna N.Y. Franklin, Dan Turetsky
arxiv-2109-07619.description: Abstract . We introduce several highness notions on degrees related to the problem of computing isomorphisms between structures, provided that isomorphisms exist. We consider variants along axes of uniformity, inclusion of negative information, and several other problems related to computing isomorphisms.

arxiv-2202-10637.title: BRST Ghost-Vertex Operator in Witten’s Cubic Open String Field Theory on Multiple D ​ p Dp -branes
arxiv-2202-10637.creator: Taejin Lee
arxiv-2202-10637.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Taejin Lee. The Becchi–Rouet–Stora–Tyutin (BRST) ghost field is a key element in constructing Witten’s cubic open string field theory. However, to date, the ghost sector of the string field theory has not received a great deal of attention. In this study, we address the BRST ghost on multiple D ​ p Dp -branes, which carries non-Abelian indices and couples to a non-Ablelian gauge field.

arxiv-2211-03718.title: Turbulent drag reduction by spanwise wall forcing. Part 2: High-Reynolds-number experiments.
arxiv-2211-03718.creator: D. Chandran 1, A. Zampiron 2, A. Rouhi 3, M. K. Fu 4, D. Wine 5 B. Holloway 5, A. J. Smits 6, I. Marusic 1
arxiv-2211-03718.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by D. Chandran 1, A. Zampiron 2, A. Rouhi 3, M. K. Fu 4, D. Wine 5 B. Holloway 5, A. J. Smits 6, I. Marusic 1. Here, we present measurements of turbulent drag reduction in boundary layers at high friction Reynolds numbers in the range of 4500 ≤ R ​ e τ ≤ 15000 4500\leq Re_{\tau}\leq 15000 .

arxiv-2211-08399.title: Active Learning Framework to Automate Network Traffic Classification
arxiv-2211-08399.creator: Jaroslav Pešek Dominik Soukup, Tomáš Čejka
arxiv-2211-08399.description: Abstract Recent network traffic classification methods benefit from machine learning (ML) technology. However, there are many challenges due to use of ML, such as: lack of high-quality annotated datasets, data-drifts and other effects causing aging of datasets and ML models, high volumes of network traffic etc.

arxiv-2304-01445.title: On the coordination efficiency of strategic multi-agent robotic teams
arxiv-2304-01445.creator: Marcos M. Vasconcelos, Behrouz Touri
arxiv-2304-01445.description: Abstract We study the problem of achieving decentralized coordination by a group of strategic decision makers choosing to engage or not in a task in a stochastic setting. First, we define a class of symmetric utility games that encompass a broad class of coordination games, including the popular framework known as global games .

arxiv-2305-07891.title: Energy-saving sub-optimal sliding mode control with bounded actuation Journal: ArXiv
arxiv-2305-07891.creator: Michael Ruderman, Alessandro Pisano, Elio Usai
arxiv-2305-07891.description: Abstract The second-order sub-optimal sliding mode control (SMC), known in the literature for the last two decades, is extended by a control-off mode which allows for saving energy during the finite time convergence. The systems with relative degree two between the sliding variable and switching control with bounded actuation are considered, while the matched upper-bounded perturbations are not necessarily continuous.

arxiv-2403-07924.title: AI and Identity
arxiv-2403-07924.creator: Sri Yash Tadimalla, Mary Lou Maher
arxiv-2403-07924.description: Abstract AI-empowered technologies’ impact on the world is undeniable, reshaping industries, revolutionizing how humans interact with technology, transforming educational paradigms, and redefining social codes. However, this rapid growth is accompanied by two notable challenges: a lack of diversity within the AI field and a widening AI divide.

arxiv-2404-00452.title: Higher Order Fractal Differential Equations
arxiv-2404-00452.creator: Alireza Khalili Golmankhaneh, Claude Depollier, Diana Pham
arxiv-2404-00452.description: Abstract This paper provides a summary of the fractal calculus framework. It presents higher-order homogeneous and nonhomogeneous linear fractal differential equations with α \alpha -order. Solutions for these equations with constant coefficients are obtained through the method of variation of parameters and the method of undetermined coefficients.

arxiv-2405-17853.title: White dwarf magnetospheres: Shielding volatile content of icy objects and implications for volatile pollution scarcity
arxiv-2405-17853.creator: Wen-Han Zhou, Shang-Fei Liu, Douglas N.C. Lin
arxiv-2405-17853.description: Abstract Context. About 25% – 50% of white dwarfs are found to be contaminated by heavy elements, which are believed to originate from external sources such as planetary materials. Elemental abundances suggest that most of the pollutants are rocky objects and only a small fraction of white dwarfs bear traces of volatile accretion. Aims.

arxiv-2406-07873.title: Robust 3D Face Alignment with Multi-Path Neural Architecture Search Thanks: This work is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (62302093), Jiangsu Province Natural Science Fund (BK20230833) and the Southeast University Start-Up Grant for New Faculty (RF1028623063). This work
arxiv-2406-07873.creator: 1 st Zhichao Jiang, 2 nd Hongsong Wang *, 3 rd Xi Teng, 4 th Baopu Li
arxiv-2406-07873.description: Abstract 3D face alignment is a very challenging and fundamental problem in computer vision. Existing deep learning-based methods manually design different networks to regress either parameters of a 3D face model or 3D positions of face vertices. However, designing such networks relies on expert knowledge, and these methods often struggle to produce consistent results across various face poses.

arxiv-2411-10697.title: Language Model Evolutionary Algorithms for Recommender Systems: Benchmarks and Algorithm Comparisons
arxiv-2411-10697.creator: Jiao Liu, Zhu Sun, Shanshan Feng, Caishun Chen, Yew-Soon Ong
arxiv-2411-10697.description: Abstract In the evolutionary computing community, the remarkable language-handling capabilities and reasoning power of large language models (LLMs) have significantly enhanced the functionality of evolutionary algorithms (EAs), enabling them to tackle optimization problems involving structured language or program code. Although this field is still in its early stages, its impressive potential has led to the development of various LLM-based EAs.

arxiv-2502-10425.title: Neuron Platonic Intrinsic Representation From Dynamics Using Contrastive Learning
arxiv-2502-10425.creator: Wei WuPeking University weiwu@stu.pku.edu.cn Can LiaoUniversity of Georgia can.liao@uga.edu Zizhen DengChinese Academy of SciencesInstitute of Automation 18803835618@163.com Zhengrui GuoThe Hong Kong University of Science and TechnologyBeijing Institute of Collaborative Innovation zguobc@connect.ust
arxiv-2502-10425.description: Abstract The Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that behind different modalities of data (what we sense or detect), there exists a universal, modality-independent representation of reality. Inspired by this hypothesis, we treat each neuron as a system, where we can detect the neuron’s multi-segment activity data under different peripheral conditions.

arxiv-2509-08786.title: Two-particle two-hole excitations in semi-inclusive neutrino-nucleus scattering
arxiv-2509-08786.creator: V. Belocchi, M.B. Barbaro, A. De Pace, M. Martini
arxiv-2509-08786.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by V. Belocchi, M.B. Barbaro, A. De Pace, M. Martini. A calculation of the two-particle two-hole contribution to the semi-inclusive ( ν μ , μ − ​ N ) (\nu_{\mu},\mu^{-}N) cross section on carbon is performed in the framework of the relativistic Fermi gas model. The process is driven by meson-exchange currents encompassing all contributions involving the exchange of a single pion and the excitation of a Δ \Delta resonance.

arxiv-2509-19959.title: OpenGL GPU-Based Rowhammer Attack (Work in Progress)
arxiv-2509-19959.creator: Antoine Plin, Frédéric Fauberteau, Nga Nguyen
arxiv-2509-19959.description: Abstract Rowhammer attacks have emerged as a significant threat to modern DRAM-based memory systems, leveraging frequent memory accesses to induce bit flips in adjacent memory cells. This work-in-progress paper presents an adaptive, many-sided Rowhammer attack utilizing GPU compute shaders to systematically achieve high-frequency memory access patterns. Our approach employs statistical distributions to optimize row targeting and avoid current mitigations.

pmc-10727887.title: A Case of Generalized Xerotic Eczema in a Patient with Congenital Insensitivity to Pain with Anhidrosis
pmc-10727887.creator: Eun Ji Hong, Hee Jung Yoon, Sul Hee Lee, Young Lip Park, SangHoon Lee
pmc-10727887.description: Congenital insensitivity to pain with anhidrosis (CIPA) is an extremely rare disease characterized by insensitivity to pain, anhidrosis, and intellectual disability. CIPA is caused by a genetic mutation in the neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase 1 (NTRK1) gene on chromosome 1. The anhidrosis leads to cutaneous changes such as skin dryness, lichenification, and impetiginization.

pmc-11312914.title: Fibromyalgia and Skin Disorders: A Systematic Review
pmc-11312914.creator: Martina D’Onghia, Jacopo Ciaffi, Laura Calabrese, Linda Tognetti, Elisa Cinotti, Pietro Rubegni, Bruno Frediani, Francesco Ursini
pmc-11312914.description: Background: Fibromyalgia is a complex multifaceted syndrome primarily characterised by chronic musculoskeletal pain, fatigue, and functional symptoms. Although FM is known to be associated with several comorbidities, the aim of this systematic review was to comprehensively examine the available evidence regarding the relationship between FM and dermatological manifestations.

pmc-11360421.title: Polymers Containing Phenothiazine, Either as a Dopant or as Part of Their Structure, for Dye-Sensitized and Bulk Heterojunction Solar Cells
pmc-11360421.creator: Muhammad Faisal Amin, Amna Anwar, Paweł Gnida, Bożena Jarząbek, Andrea Ehrmann
pmc-11360421.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Potential photovoltaic technology includes the newly developed dye-sensitized solar cells (DSSCs) and bulk heterojunction (BHJ) solar cells. Owing to their diverse qualities, polymers can be employed in third-generation photovoltaic cells to specifically alter their device elements and frameworks. Polymers containing phenothiazine, either as a part of their structure or as a dopant, are easy and economical to synthesize, are soluble in common organic solvents, and have the potential to acquire desired electrochemical and photophysical properties by mere tuning of their chemical structures.

pmc-11606372.title: Establishment of a surveillance program for anal cancer in Crohn's disease
pmc-11606372.creator: Hajime Kayano, Ken-Ichi Okada, Seiichiro Yamamoto, Kazuo Koyanagi
pmc-11606372.description: This letter discusses the incidence of anal cancer among Crohn's disease (CD)-related malignancies. Patients with CD have been demonstrated to be at a higher risk of developing small bowel and colorectal cancers than healthy individuals. Although CD-associated anal cancer is relatively rare, patients with CD accompanied by anal or perianal lesions are at increased risk of anal cancer.

pmc-11638755.title: Hemiarthroplasty for Hip Fracture in Down Syndrome: A Retrospective Series of Five Cases
pmc-11638755.creator: Ahmed Nageeb Mahmoud, John Paul Prodoehl, Maria F. Echeverry-Martinez, Daniel S. Horwitz
pmc-11638755.description: PurposeThere is limited evidence regarding the outcomes of hip hemiarthroplasty (HA) following trauma in individuals living with Down syndrome (DS). This study aims to summarize the outcomes of hip HA in a series of individuals living with DS following femoral neck fractures.

pmc-11772413.title: Role of the ventral portion of intermediate arcopallium in stability of female Bengalese finch song preferences
pmc-11772413.creator: Austin Coulter, Jonathan F. Prather
pmc-11772413.description: The process of decision making is a complex procedure influenced by both external and internal conditions. Songbirds provide an excellent model to investigate the neural mechanisms of decision making, because females rely on acoustic signals called songs as important stimuli in directing their mate choice.

pmc-12820382.title: In tendons, differing physiological requirements lead to distinct patterns of MMP-1 degradation
pmc-12820382.creator: Kelsey Y Gsell, Laurent Kreplak, Samuel P Veres
pmc-12820382.description: Collagen fibrils from high-stress, energy-storing tendons critical to locomotion are smaller in diameter with increased intermolecular crosslinking compared to fibrils from low-stress, positional tendons. This results in distinct loading mechanics thought to limit fatigue damage in energy-storing tendons. However, there appears to be a functional trade-off with energy-storing tendons also having reduced remodeling ability.

pmc-12827516.title: Descriptive epidemiology of animal-induced injuries in Sandun Town, Hangzhou, China
pmc-12827516.creator: Qilong Wang, Lvzhao Liao, Da Sun, Junfeng Zhao
pmc-12827516.description: ObjectiveTo summarize epidemiological features of animal-induced injury patients using the emergency department medical record system, and provide recommendations for improving animal-induced injury prevention and immunization practices.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted based on data of animal-induced injury patients treated at the Animal Bite Clinic of the Emergency Department of Zhejiang Hospital from January 1 to December 31, 2024.

pmc-12837377.title: Sustaining Edible Grass (Rumex patientia L. × Rumex tianschanicus Losinsk.) Through Summer Lethal Stress: Multi-Omics Reveals Shading-Mediated Mitigation of High Light-Aggravated Heat Damage
pmc-12837377.creator: Zengyang He, Qinzhuo Zhong, Xinyao Li, Miaofen Chen, Wei Liu, Tao Jiang, Jianfeng Zou
pmc-12837377.description: Edible Grass (EG) is a hybrid vegetable variety valued for its high biomass and protein content, garnering significant interest in recent years for its potential in food, feed, and health product applications. However, in subtropical climates, intense light and high temperatures severely affect the growth and development of Edible Grass (EG), leading to substantial reductions in yield and quality.

pmc-13193508.title: Assessing attention towards plants: Development and first steps to the validation of the Hidden Object Picture Instrument (HOPI)
pmc-13193508.creator: Peter Pany, Benno Dünser, Dawn Lorraine Sanders, Lisa Anna Pernausl, Kerstin Kranner, Manuel Wenzlik, Dagmar Fister, Andrea Möller, Peter Lampert, Washington Ferreira Júnior, Washington Ferreira Júnior, Washington Ferreira Júnior, Washington Ferreira Júnior
pmc-13193508.description: Public awareness of plants remains limited despite their essential ecological and societal roles. A major challenge in addressing this issue is the absence of validated instruments that measure attentional-memory processes regarding plants. This study introduces the Hidden Object Picture Instrument (HOPI), a novel visual tool designed to assess plant-directed attention in complex natural scenes.

pmc-13538231.title: Responsiveness and minimal important change of the Dutch Adult Strabismus-20 Questionnaire (Dutch-AS-20)
pmc-13538231.creator: Fenna Burggraaf, Hinke Marijke Jellema, Martha J Tjon-Fo-Sang, Ruth M A van Nispen, Ellen B M Elsman
pmc-13538231.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeThe Dutch Adult Strabismus-20 questionnaire (Dutch-AS-20) is a patient-reported outcome measure (PROM) developed to assess the strabismus-specific quality of life (QoL) in adult patients with strabismus in the Netherlands. This 18-item questionnaire comprises a psychosocial and visual function subscale. The aim of this prospective, multicenter, longitudinal study was to evaluate the responsiveness and determine the minimal important change (MIC) of the Dutch-AS-20 in patients undergoing strabismus surgery.MethodsAdult patients scheduled for strabismus surgery were enrolled.

pmc-13583981.title: Randomized phase II trial of zolbetuximab as second-line treatment in patients with claudin 18.2-positive advanced gastric/GEJ cancer with previous zolbetuximab exposure: ZELDA
pmc-13583981.creator: C. Inagaki, E. Oki, K. Ando, H. Hirano, M. Furuta, Y. Narita, T. Esaki, K. Murotani, H. Kawakami, K. Muro
pmc-13583981.description: BackgroundZolbetuximab, an anti-claudin 18.2 (CLDN18.2) monoclonal antibody, combined with fluoropyrimidine- and platinum-based chemotherapy, is established as first-line standard of care for patients with CLDN18.2-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) cancer, based on the phase III SPOTLIGHT and GLOW trials.
